title: GTA6 Limited Edition Controller Revealed at September 2026 State of Play
description: Sony's back-to-back State of Play showcases brought major game updates, including a surprise reveal of a GTA6 limited edition controller.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Sony Breaks New Ground with Back-to-Back State of Play Showcases

In a first-of-its-kind broadcasting strategy, Sony recently delivered two State of Play livestreams back-to-back, giving the global gaming community a massive double feature. The event kicked off with a standard showcase packed with general announcements, followed immediately by a dedicated State of Play Japan broadcast highlighting projects from Japanese and Asian developers. Together, the dual streams served up an impressive wave of reveals and updates.

## Main Showcase Highlights and the GTA6 Controller Reveal

The primary State of Play stream delivered updates on several major titles. Fans were treated to fresh content for Gran Turismo 7, another look at Saros, and a striking new presentation for Final Fantasy 7 Revelation. Alongside these heavy-hitting game updates, the broadcast also featured various smaller announcements, most notably a **GTA6 limited edition controller**.

While details were concise during the rapid-fire presentation, the appearance of official GTA6 merchandise has naturally sparked widespread discussion and excitement across the community as players look ahead to the game's release.

## A Global Snapshot of Upcoming PlayStation Content

Following the main event, the Japan-focused stream maintained the momentum by shining a spotlight on regional developers, proving that Sony's dual-format approach successfully catered to diverse gaming tastes. Media outlets and community polls are currently evaluating the overall success of this unprecedented double-showcase format.

## Editor's Take
Sony's decision to run two State of Play broadcasts back-to-back proved to be an effective way to pack a massive punch. While heavyweight updates like Gran Turismo 7 and Final Fantasy 7 dominated the runtime, sneaking in a GTA6 limited edition controller was a brilliant touch to keep franchise anticipation steadily building.
